what_happened: TV was awake in the client, paused inside Archer S08E05 at 10:57/20:20 with the transport overlay up and focus on Play. Server PlaybackProgress for episode 781 shows position 657/1220 updated 08:02:01, so the paused session was still beaconing correctly.

step: Home -> the next episode after leaving playback
what_happened: Back from a paused player lands on Home in 1 press — good. But the Continue Watching list is fetched once at app start and never refreshed: the TV offered 'Archer (2009) S08E04 46%' while the server's /api/playback/continue-watching returned S08E05 at 53.9% first, and the DB row for S08E05 had just been updated (657/1220 s). Every episode watched after launch leaves Home one episode behind, so the owner has to go Series -> season -> episode to find the real next thing.
expected: Home offers the episode that was just left, at its saved position, with no navigation detour
verdict: DEFECT — client caches continueWatchingProvider for the app lifetime.
evidence: screenshots /tmp/tv2.png (paused S08E05) and /tmp/home-back.png (Home offers S08E04 46%); server continue-watching returned mediaId 781 S8E5 53.9%; DB PlaybackProgress 781 position 657 updated 15:44:21

step: TV-off semantics: does the display ever sleep?
what_happened: The client had been paused on one frame since 08:01 (identical screenshot sha256 at 15:36). Wake Locks size=0, so no app or player holds the device awake; the display stays on because the device setting mScreenOffTimeoutSetting=2147483646 (effectively never) — a device/developer-option setting on the Shield, not Mediarr holding a lock.
expected: the display sleeps on its own idle timeout, or the app returns to Home after a long pause
verdict: NOT an app defect (device setting). Flagged for the owner: whether the TV should be allowed to sleep is their call; also a candidate UX improvement (auto-exit a paused player after N minutes) if the setting stays as is.

what_happened: Back is consumed Kodi-style and only toggles the HUD (deliberate, owner report 2026-11-08), so leaving playback needs the unlabeled Stop button: Back -> Up -> Right -> Right -> Select, 5 presses, while the HUD auto-hides after ~4 s and focus lands on an unexpected control if you are slow. Trying it at adb speed skipped to the next episode and seeked (S08E05 -> S08E06, position 740 -> 1127) instead of exiting. KEYCODE_MEDIA_STOP exits cleanly in one key.
expected: one obvious press leaves playback and saves the position, without hunting an unlabeled corner button
verdict: OPEN — candidate fix: keep Back as HUD-toggle (owner asked) but pause the auto-hide timer while focus is inside the HUD, and give Stop a text label plus a direct key path so exit is deterministic.
evidence: screenshots /tmp/exit1..exit4.png and /tmp/playing1.png; DB position jumps 740 -> 1127; media-stop (keyevent 86) exits in one press

what_happened: Each pass reports 'imported N' (3–5) with no new files appearing in the library, and this pass also logged '[BulkImport] Failed to import /data/TV/Archer (2009)': fetch failed' and the same for Mr. Inbetween (metadata fetch over the VPN). The pass re-attempts folding folders that are already library series, so it burns a 2-minute window per pass and could duplicate a series when the metadata fetch does succeed.
expected: a pass over an unchanged library imports nothing and reports nothing
verdict: OPEN (server). Two sub-defects to separate next cycle: (a) counters report 'imported' for files already in place, (b) library folders are re-attempted as fresh imports instead of being recognised as known series.
evidence: journal 16:01:29, 16:02:21, 16:03:27 ('Folder import: scanned 603, skipped 602, imported 3, failed 2'); no new files under /data/TV or /data/Movies since 07:37; Series count unchanged at 43

step: post-import scan after a paused session (verification of the gate)
what_happened: The 16:31 pass still logged 'a playback session is actively progressing' while the client had the position frozen at 791 s since 16:09. Cause: the gate is conservative for a session it has never seen, and the row it had snapshotted at 16:03 was a different episode (781 -> 782 when a stray key skipped). So the position-based gate converges only on the following pass.
expected: a paused session is not treated as live within one pass
verdict: Gate is correct but conservative by one pass; the root cause is the client beaconing while paused. Client fix (report only while playing; write once on pause/seek/stop) built into APK 121 next.
evidence: journal 16:31:09 deferred + DB PlaybackProgress 782 position 791 frozen since 16:09; gate snapshot mismatch 781 -> 782

what_happened: The 16:31 pass reported 'imported 5, failed 0' with no BulkImport failures (network recovered) — and yet no new media file appeared anywhere under /data, nor any new MediaFileVariant row.
